title: GadgetsmeNetwork
description: A NeoForge 1.21.1 mod that integrates Building Gadgets 2 with Applied Energistics 2, adding a "Order from AE" function to the material list screen.
body:
## Features

- **Import items from AE2**: Adds an "Order from AE" button to the Building Gadgets 2 material list screen
- **AE2 network integration**: When clicked, automatically extracts the required building materials from the connected AE2 network
- **Smart matching**: Automatically searches the AE2 network for corresponding items based on the material list
- **One-click refill**: Transfers missing materials directly from the AE2 system to the player's inventory

## Usage

1. Open a Building Gadgets 2 tool (e.g., Construction Gadget) in Building Gadgets 2
2. Navigate to the material list screen
3. Click the "Order from AE" button
4. The mod will automatically scan the AE2 network and extract the required items into the player's inventory

## Requirements

| Dependency           | Required | Version   |
|----------------------|----------|-----------|
| NeoForge             | Yes      | ≥21.1     |
| Applied Energistics 2| Yes      | 1.21.1    |
| Building Gadgets 2   | Yes      | 1.21.1    |
